title: Fibrewise zero sections pull back to zero through a reduced scheme
statement: Let i:R -> X and g:T -> R be morphisms of schemes, with R reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. Let M be a finite locally free module on X [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], U an open of X and m a section of M on U. Suppose that for every r in R with i(r) in U, the germ of m at i(r) tensored with 1 in kappa_X(i(r)) is zero. For every open V of T contained in (g followed by i)^(-1)(U), the restriction to V of the canonical section 1 tensor m in the tensor pullback of M [def-pc-module-pullback] is zero. Neither T nor X is assumed reduced.

source.place: Tag 01J1, lemma-reduced; local-basis form of the reduced-locus argument in Varieties Tag 0FD6, lemma-bertini

proof.text: Trivialize M in a neighbourhood of each relevant source point and intersect this neighbourhood with U. The existing local-frame and stalk-basis lemmas give coordinates a_j and a stalk basis. Apply the tensor of each basis coordinate functional with the identity to the assumed zero tensor, then contract O_x tensor kappa(x). Each a_j evaluates to zero at every i(r) lying in this open.

The evaluation-naturality formula sends these scalar zeros to zero residue values of i^*(a_j). Its basic open is empty. Since R is reduced, eq_zero_of_basicOpen_eq_bot makes i^*(a_j) zero. Ring-section functoriality then gives (g followed by i)^*(a_j)=0 without any reducedness assumption on T.

Use the section-normalized tensor-pullback adjunction: its unit is additive, semilinear, and commutes with restriction. Apply it to the finite frame expansion of m. Each summand has a zero coefficient, so the local pulled-back section is zero. Pass to germs on V and use section extensionality to conclude.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorPullbackSection_eq_zero_of_reduced_factor
    {X R T : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced R] (i : R ⟶ X) (g : T ⟶ R)
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (U : X.Opens) (m : Γ(M, U))
    (hm : ∀ (r : R) (hr : i r ∈ U),
      letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk (i r)) (X.residueField (i r)) :=
        Module.compHom (X.residueField (i r)) (X.residue (i r)).hom
      (M.presheaf.germ U (i r) hr m ⊗ₜ[X.presheaf.stalk (i r)]
        (1 : X.residueField (i r))) = 0)
    (V : T.Opens) (hV : V ≤ (g ≫ i) ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    ((tensorPullback (g ≫ i)).obj M).presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op
      (tensorPullbackSection (g ≫ i) M U m) = 0
